Portugal Travel Hub

Independent editorial portal covering Portuguese coastal tourism.
We charge for the verification we do, never for placement.
Coverage: beaches, surf, fishing, webcams and verified experiences
across the Portuguese coast - Algarve, Lisbon, Setubal, Costa
Vicentina, Madeira, Azores.

About the editorial team

About Ricardo Barbosa, Founder & Editor: Italian citizen, twenty years in premium hospitality between Dublin (Jurys Inns, O'Callaghan, Four Seasons, InterContinental) and Portugal (Pine Cliffs, Biorganico, Bricia Du Mar).

Affiliate links (GetYourGuide, Amazon Associates) disclosed in
